signal.title: Develop Humanoid Robot Policies End-to-End with NVIDIA Isaac GR00T
signal.summary: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。

editorial.intro: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。
editorial.why_it_matters: VLA 的记忆、推理和实时执行能力，直接决定具身智能能否从演示动作走向长时任务和真实部署。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对实验是否覆盖真实机器人、长时任务和跨场景泛化。

evidence.excerpt: Develop Humanoid Robot Policies End-to-End with NVIDIA Isaac GR00T | NVIDIA Technical Blog DEVELOPER Home Blog Forums Docs Downloads Training Join Technical Blog Subscribe Related Resources Robotics English 中文 Develop Humanoid Robot Policies End-to-End with NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Jul 07, 2026 By Edith Llontop and Brandon Neel Like Discuss (1) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary Like Dislike The NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Development Platform provides an open, modular, and fully integrated end-to-end workflow for developing, training, evaluating, and deploying humanoid robotics policies, spanning from simulation environment setup and teleoperation-based data collection to post-training and real-world deployment using the NVIDIA software stack. GR00T 1.7 introduces a vision-language-action model pretrained on approximately 32,000 hours of real human demonstration and 8,000 hours of simulation, incorporating a Cosmos-Reason2-2B backbone (Qwen3-VL), robust ONNX/TensorRT export, and enhanced task decomposition for improved generalization, long-horizon reasoning, and cross-embodiment deployment.
